diplomas.title: OTHM Level 3 Diploma in Business Management
diplomas.summary: A UK Level 3 business qualification that builds foundations in communication, people management, customer service, finance and marketing.
entry: Capability to undertake the course, confirmed at enrolment
Evidence of English language competency if you are not from a majority English-speaking country
progression: OTHM Level 4 Diploma in Business Management
Many universities may consider holders for direct entry to bachelor's degrees
diplomas.certificate: Awarded by OTHM, a UK awarding organisation regulated by Ofqual. MHEC supports your study online.

diplomas.title: OTHM Level 4 Diploma in Business Management
diplomas.summary: Equivalent to the first year of a UK bachelor's degree, covering operations, communication, finance, leadership and global business.
entry: A relevant Level 3 diploma, two A-levels or equivalent, or management experience for mature learners over 21
Evidence of English language competency if you are not from a majority English-speaking country
progression: OTHM Level 5 Extended Diploma in Business Management
Direct entry into Year 2 of a three-year UK bachelor's degree
diplomas.certificate: Awarded by OTHM, a UK awarding organisation regulated by Ofqual. MHEC supports your study online.

diplomas.title: OTHM Level 5 Extended Diploma in Business Management
diplomas.summary: Equivalent to the first two years of a UK bachelor's degree, leading to a final-year top-up to complete your degree.
entry: A relevant Level 3 diploma, two A-levels or equivalent, or management experience for mature learners over 21
Evidence of English language competency if you are not from a majority English-speaking country
progression: OTHM Level 6 Diploma in Business Management
Direct entry into Year 3 (final-year top-up) of a three-year UK bachelor's degree
diplomas.certificate: Awarded by OTHM, a UK awarding organisation regulated by Ofqual. MHEC supports your study online.

diplomas.title: OTHM Level 5 Diploma in Information Technology
diplomas.summary: A UK Level 5 IT qualification in software engineering, databases, systems analysis, networks and IT project management.
entry: A relevant Level 4 diploma or equivalent
Evidence of English language competency if you are not from a majority English-speaking country
progression: OTHM Level 6 Diploma in Information Technology
Direct entry into the final year of a three-year UK bachelor's degree
diplomas.certificate: Awarded by OTHM, a UK awarding organisation regulated by Ofqual. MHEC supports your study online.

diplomas.title: OTHM Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership
diplomas.summary: A master's-level qualification for managers that leads to an MBA top-up with advanced standing at partner UK universities.
entry: An honours degree, a UK Level 6 diploma or equivalent, or management experience for mature learners
Evidence of English language competency if you are not from a majority English-speaking country
modules: Two optional units from: Strategic Financial Management, Supply Chain and Operations Management, Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Globalisation and Corporate Governance, Strategic Change Management, Strategic Marketing
progression: MBA top-up with advanced standing (a further 60-credit dissertation stage with a university)
Career progression into senior management roles
diplomas.certificate: Awarded by OTHM, a UK awarding organisation regulated by Ofqual. MHEC supports your study online.
